paper_language_rule: Any publication must state: tasks were generated and reviewed by the authors; a single author/user confirmation closed the review; no independent or double-blind human review was performed. External300 is an author-generated, author-reviewed controlled benchmark used for direction-consistency checks on a larger task set, not an independent external evaluation.
